notes.title: 08/09/2021 Update!
notes.content:
It's been a while,
We're really happy to announce a new update!


- The H scene of Eris has been reworked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/1546522cd1e2536cd32dd83ee1404c67cbe81cd0.png[/img]

There were constant askings, and I think this is the answer!



- A New character : Betty

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/005ac068293777190ecaebe34a00af52f15e4a20.png[/img]

Let's do some orc hunt with Betty! Drink messed potions and let's find out what is true and not.



- About remaining updates

We originally planned ISEKAI QUEST with 6 characters total at first.
So any additional characters would deliver in the DLC, that was the plan.

But after a long discussion,
we decided to deliver 2 more characters, with Free updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/3274ab2c218ffc91d550d1725588f73449c6f81e.png[/img]


Sorry that can not tell the specific schedule at the moment,
We were a very small team with part-time developers lately
But we could keep updating and developing thanks to your supports!

We wish you enjoy this update.
Thank you!

tags.feature: - The H scene of Eris has been reworked!
we decided to deliver 2 more characters, with Free updates!

notes.title: Winner is Yuria!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/2cb35491fafe155a64db53f898bf2cd7c34dfcf6.png[/img]

- Yuria's New H scene is added and replaced!
You can also access the old H scene through Replay.


 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/0a42e7858a8914ecdc3303c98c21304a8235e8e9.png[/img]

- The last vote was a close fight, and the winner is Yuria!
Thank you all for participating!

- To Eris fans, Don't be disappointed with the results!
It is hard to tell the specific schedule but Eris's H scene will be also reworked in the future!



* About the new game mode we mentioned in the last announcement,
It is delayed and we're still developing it.
Sorry for your waiting but please take a little more patient,
we're working very hard to give you a better game experience!



Other changes
- The effect of Sage's Stone is changed : 
Before : Revives player with 25% of HP.
After : When taking fatal damage, Revives player with 25 HP.

- Now Shymi's Dropped Coin can be removed by Mushroom.


Thank you!

tags.feature: - Yuria's New H scene is added and replaced!

tags.balance_change: - The effect of Sage's Stone is changed : Before : Revives player with 25% of HP. After : When taking fatal damage, Revives player with 25 HP.

tags.feature: - Now Shymi's Dropped Coin can be removed by Mushroom.

notes.title: 1.0.10 Update!
notes.content:
- The volume controller is now separated into BGM and SFX.
- Chinese translation is updated (except dialogues)
- Eris's H scene is not accessible without True Vision anymore.
- Minor bug fixes, etc

- Users can now access and fix the localization file directly.

Thanks to the community,
lots of guys helped and offered translate even after launch.
So we opened the script sheet so users could freely edit scripts in-game!

Localization.csv file path

Windows
IntallDIR/ISEKAI QUEST/ISEKAI QUEST_Data/StreamingAssets
macOS
InstallDIR/Contents/Resources/Data/StreamingAssets

Here is the current progress of translating :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/542db3d5b3914d5ceeb095dfcb98fd13b9ad0908.png[/img]

Feel free to contact us for adding/fixing translations!
